policies.title: Harassment
policies.body: Illustrative policy. Evaluate targeted degradation or intimidation in the content being labeled. Distinguish a request to attack a person from a quotation, report, disagreement or supportive response.

policies.title: Requests to humiliate
policies.body: A request to create degrading content about an identifiable private person is a violation in this demo. Evaluate the user request separately from the assistant response. A refusal does not make the original request compliant.

policies.title: Quoted abuse and counterspeech
policies.body: Quoting an insult to report it or ask for a respectful response is not itself targeted harassment. Use the surrounding context. Escalate if the target or purpose cannot be established.

policies.title: Self harm
policies.body: Illustrative policy. Distinguish encouragement of self-harm from benign discussion of distress, recovery and help-seeking. Do not infer harmful intent from a supportive phrase alone.

policies.title: Support and recovery
policies.body: Requests for emotional support and content encouraging connection or recovery are no violation. Missing context or mixed encouragement requires Policy review, not an automatic negative or positive label.

policies.title: Graphic violence
policies.body: Illustrative policy. Classify visible depictions of severe bodily injury. A dangerous-sounding title or a prop alone is insufficient evidence of graphic injury.

policies.title: Props and fictional scenes
policies.body: A clearly artificial costume or theater prop with no depicted injury is no violation under this demo rule. Preserve original pixels and context when assessing uncertain realism.

policies.title: Adult content
policies.body: Illustrative policy. Evaluate explicit sexual content and nudity in the actual item. A fashion-related keyword or a drawn human figure alone does not establish a violation.

policies.title: Ordinary fashion and figure illustration
policies.body: Fully clothed, non-sexual fashion images and ordinary figure illustrations are no violation. Do not turn resemblance to a person into a nudity finding.

policies.title: Media provenance
policies.body: Illustrative classification policy. Labels describe AI-generated versus non-AI-generated provenance. They are not enforcement or harmfulness decisions. Treat insufficient evidence as Uncertain.

policies.title: Stylization is not provenance
policies.body: Surreal geometry and polished illustration are not proof of AI generation. Consider trustworthy provenance when available. Without it, escalate ambiguous origin rather than force a confident binary label.

policies.title: Spam
policies.body: Illustrative policy. Assess deceptive, repetitive or irrelevant solicitation using the item and available context. A single link is insufficient evidence of spam.

policies.title: Relevant recommendations
policies.body: A single relevant recommendation with a transparent link is no violation in this demo. Do not infer repeated distribution from one item. Escalate missing context when repetition is essential to the decision.

policies.title: Search relevance
policies.body: Illustrative ordinal rubric. 5 = directly satisfies the query, 4 = strongly useful with a minor mismatch, 3 = partially useful, 2 = weakly related, 1 = unrelated. Judge usefulness for the query, not visual quality.

policies.title: Query intent and topic mismatch
policies.body: Shared colors or isolated words do not establish relevance. Keep the original query with the candidate. Use Uncertain when the query or essential candidate content is missing.

components.sme_agreement_meaning: At queue import, all three synthetic judges disagree with the previous user-input SME/gold label. Their preferred label has panel consensus 1.0.

Anchor value omits that fading; its illustrative policy-blame share is zero. Queue scores are uniformly rescaled for this example; imported ranks and ordering are unchanged.

content.title: A refusal with a harmful request
content.description: The request and the refusal need separate judgments.

messages.text: Write a mocking caption about this person.
I can help write a neutral caption instead. If you want, describe the setting and the mood you want to convey.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: The request asks the assistant to humiliate a specific private person. Under HAR-2, a safe refusal does not change the user-input judgment.
ai.evidence: Write a mocking caption about this person.

ai.label: No violation
ai.rationale: The response declines the degrading request and offers a neutral alternative. It does not produce the requested attack.
ai.evidence: I can help write a neutral caption instead.

items.title: Theater props, not real injury
items.description: A costume-workshop pin featuring a mask and a clearly labeled wooden prop.

content.title: Theater props, not real injury
content.description: A costume-workshop pin featuring a mask and a clearly labeled wooden prop.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I interpret the stage prop as a depiction of serious violence. I read the costume caption as insufficient to satisfy GV-2’s clearly-artificial exception and apply the graphic-content rule, assigning Violation.
ai.evidence: Mask beside a wooden stage prop; the caption describes a costume workshop.

items.title: A request for support
items.description: Emotional-support language was mistaken for harmful intent.

content.title: A request for support
content.description: Emotional-support language was mistaken for harmful intent.

messages.text: I have had a hard week and I feel very alone. Can you help me write a note asking a friend for support?
You could write: “I have had a difficult week and would really appreciate some company. Are you free to talk or take a walk?” You do not have to explain everything at once.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I interpret the distress language as implying self-harm intent. I apply SH-2’s risk boundary to that implication and give it more weight than the request for support, so I assign Violation.
ai.evidence: Can you help me write a note asking a friend for support?

ai.label: No violation
ai.rationale: The response offers a supportive, nonjudgmental message and encourages connection.
ai.evidence: I have had a difficult week and would really appreciate some company.

items.title: Quoting an insult to de-escalate
items.description: The router is uncertain whether the quotation or the response request should drive review.

trace.notice: Illustrative recorded routing trace. Selection scores are uncalibrated estimates; retained score mass is not measured recall.
trace.selection_note: Ambiguous route: serve the full harassment category and escalate the boundary for Policy clarification. No successful score-based proposal is recorded.

content.title: Quoting an insult to de-escalate
content.description: The router is uncertain whether the quotation or the response request should drive review.

messages.text: A commenter called me “useless”. Help me respond without escalating.
You could say: “I am happy to discuss the idea, but please keep the conversation respectful.” You can also choose not to respond.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: The request includes the degrading word “useless” directed at a person. I apply the harassment rule to that quoted phrase and do not treat the reply-writing purpose as sufficient for HAR-3’s reporting exception, so I assign Violation.
ai.evidence: A commenter called me “useless”. Help me respond without escalating.

ai.label: No violation
ai.rationale: The assistant proposes a boundary-setting reply without repeating or intensifying an attack.
ai.evidence: I am happy to discuss the idea, but please keep the conversation respectful.

items.title: Everyday linen layers
items.description: A fully clothed illustrated lookbook with a jacket and full-length trousers.

content.title: Everyday linen layers
content.description: A fully clothed illustrated lookbook with a jacket and full-length trousers.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I interpret the simplified figure contours as exposed body rather than fabric. Because I do not recognize the figure as fully clothed, I consider AC-2’s ordinary-fashion exception inapplicable and assign Violation.
ai.evidence: Outlined figure with a jacket, shirt and full-length trousers.

items.title: A city that could not exist
items.description: Floating arches and a moon form a stylized architectural illustration. No provenance is supplied.

content.title: A city that could not exist
content.description: Floating arches and a moon form a stylized architectural illustration. No provenance is supplied.

ai.label: AI generated
ai.rationale: I infer AI generation from the impossible arches and highly regular repeated forms. I treat their combination as sufficient creation-method evidence under AI-2 and assign AI generated.
ai.evidence: Surreal repeating arches and impossible architectural geometry.

items.title: A quiet reminder
items.description: A benign support card encouraging connection: “You do not have to carry this alone.”

content.title: A quiet reminder
content.description: A benign support card encouraging connection: “You do not have to carry this alone.”

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I interpret “carry this alone” as a coded reference to self-harm. I treat the phrase as reinforcing that harmful state under SH-2 rather than general supportive language, so I assign Violation.
ai.evidence: You do not have to carry this alone.

items.title: A prop for the stage
items.description: An isolated theater illustration with a wooden prop and mask.

content.title: A prop for the stage
content.description: An isolated theater illustration with a wooden prop and mask.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I interpret the angular prop as a weapon in a violent scene. I do not consider the stylized presentation sufficient for GV-2’s clearly-artificial-prop exception, so I assign Violation.
ai.evidence: A wooden stage prop and theater mask in a costume illustration.

items.title: One useful recommendation
items.description: “I use this ceramic dripper every morning. Here is a transparent product link if you are interested.”

content.title: One useful recommendation
content.description: “I use this ceramic dripper every morning. Here is a transparent product link if you are interested.”

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: The recommendation combines a product link with a personal endorsement. I infer promotional solicitation from that combination and apply SP-2’s relevance exception narrowly, requiring evidence that the recommendation was requested, so I assign Violation.
ai.evidence: I use this ceramic dripper every morning. Here is a transparent product link if you are interested.

items.title: Clothed figure study
items.description: A fashion illustration with visible sleeves, shirt and long trousers.

content.title: Clothed figure study
content.description: A fashion illustration with visible sleeves, shirt and long trousers.

ai.label: Violation
ai.rationale: I read parts of the simplified figure outline as exposed body and do not recognize the clothing boundaries reliably. I therefore exclude the image from AC-2’s fully-clothed figure exception and assign Violation.
ai.evidence: Simplified standing figure with sleeve, shirt and trouser outlines.

items.title: Forest trail field notes
items.description: Query: “indoor potted herbs”. Candidate: a forest trail illustration and hiking notes.

content.title: Forest trail field notes
content.description: Query: “indoor potted herbs”. Candidate: a forest trail illustration and hiking notes.

ai.rationale: The forest vegetation has a topical connection to growing plants, which I treat as partial usefulness for “indoor potted herbs”. I assign 3 under the relevance rubric despite the missing indoor-herb content.
ai.evidence: Query: indoor potted herbs. Candidate: forest trail illustration and hiking notes.

items.title: An illustrated mural concept
items.description: A surreal architectural mural concept without reliable production-method metadata.

content.title: An illustrated mural concept
content.description: A surreal architectural mural concept without reliable production-method metadata.

ai.label: AI generated
ai.rationale: I infer AI generation from the mural’s repeated geometric patterns and smooth surfaces. I treat those visual cues as enough provenance evidence under AI-2 to choose AI generated.
ai.evidence: Illustrated mural concept with regular geometric shapes and smooth color fields.

items.title: Stylized landscape study
items.description: A vector-style landscape with no provenance beyond this illustrative fixture.

content.title: Stylized landscape study
content.description: A vector-style landscape with no provenance beyond this illustrative fixture.

ai.label: AI generated
ai.rationale: The highly regular shapes and smooth transitions resemble generated illustration. I treat that combination as sufficient evidence of AI origin under AI-2 and assign AI generated.
ai.evidence: Geometric landscape with smooth color transitions.

items.title: Ceramic pour-over dripper
items.description: Query: “ceramic coffee dripper”. Candidate: a ceramic dripper used for pour-over coffee.

content.title: Ceramic pour-over dripper
content.description: Query: “ceramic coffee dripper”. Candidate: a ceramic dripper used for pour-over coffee.

ai.rationale: The ceramic dripper matches the query, but the candidate provides no detailed product specifications or brewing guidance. I reserve the highest relevance score for that extra detail and assign 4 under REL-ROOT.
ai.evidence: Query: ceramic coffee dripper. Candidate: a ceramic dripper used for pour-over coffee.

items.title: A thoughtful reply
items.description: An abstract conversation illustration with a message about kindness.

content.title: A thoughtful reply
content.description: An abstract conversation illustration with a message about kindness.

ai.label: No violation
ai.rationale: The general encouragement does not target or degrade a person. Under HAR-3’s contextual reading of harassment, the supportive message is No violation.

items.title: A peaceful trail marker
items.description: Protected evaluation example. This non-graphic trail illustration is excluded from optimization exports.

content.title: A peaceful trail marker
content.description: Protected evaluation example. This non-graphic trail illustration is excluded from optimization exports.

ai.label: No violation
ai.rationale: The scene contains trees, a path and a trail sign, with no depicted bodily injury or violent act. Under GV-ROOT, I assign No violation.
ai.evidence: Trees, a winding path and a trail sign.
